items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: George Lewis, I had a fella at that time we used to call him E-String. We used to call him E. We used to call him Big E. But he was playing with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, he bought a home over the road and his wife died.

And he came back here and I haven't seen the hood of George Lewis. He still has his home there. He's out on the road now, right now. I ain't seen that man, right there in Manneville. That's why he came. I ain't seen him no more. I ain't seen that man since he needed to be with his wife. Really? I was at the funeral. I ain't seen him in that day to listen. George Lewis, I had a fella at that time we used to call him E-String. We used to call him E. We used to call him Big E. But he was playing with us.
We used to call him E-String because when he first started to learn how to play, he loved to play all the time on the E-String. He was like Eastring. We could call it Eastring.
It wasn't Chester Zardis, wasn't it Chester?
No, no. You talking about Chester Jones?
